type-xs.$description: Smallest text anywhere: labels and captions.

type-caps-tracking.$description: The only positive letter-spacing: uppercase labels (stamps, table heads, field captions).

type-normal-tracking.$description: Resets inherited caps tracking for lowercase details inside uppercase labels.

type-display-tracking.$description: Tightening for display headings at 2xl and above; semi-expanded letters carry their own air, so it stays small.

type-display-width.$description: Archivo width axis (wdth) for display headings and money figures: SemiExpanded, the signage width. Interface text stays at 100.

type-6xl.$description: MARKET hero headline on wide containers only.

type-statement.$description: One oversized statement per MARKET page (after Bélanger): sized by its container (cqw), so it fills a section at any width.
